set.body:
One minor version after the deprecation warnings land. Target signature:

  fmri_lm(formula, block, dataset, baseline_model = NULL, durations = 0,
          control = fmri_lm_control(), compute = compute_spec(),
          engine = NULL, ...)

Also delete the now-dead normalization helpers: .fmri_lm_normalize_ar_options,
.fmri_lm_normalize_robust_options, .fmri_lm_normalize_preprocessing_options, and
the shorthand-handling half of .fmri_lm_build_config (~225 lines of support code
today).

Note dots$ar_options / dots$robust_options and the engine_ar_options /
engine_robust_options plumbing (R/fmrilm.R:204-205, :267-268, :297-299, :390-391)
are already dead code - both names are formals of both S3 methods, so they can
never land in dots, and there is no third fmri_lm method.
set.title: Remove the deprecated argument surface
